meta.plant_name: Evergy Kansas Central 2025 IRP power station 1

Status.note: The Evergy plan update decks from May 2025 and June 2026 both show 710 MW of natural gas for Kansas Central in 2031. So the unit is still a planned addition and the status stays announced.

Capacity (MW).note: Both plan decks show 710 MW of natural gas added for Kansas Central in 2031.

Start year.note: Both plan decks show the 710 MW addition in 2031. The decks assume an April 1 in-service date.

units.notes: This plant has no real site. It is a placeholder for capacity in the Evergy Kansas Central plan update of May 2025, so no location, city or coordinates were researched. The newest report is the June 2026 plan update, which is within a year, so Latest Activity is left alone. The two new Kansas Central blocks that are real sites are Viola for 2029 and McNew for 2030, each 355 MW as Kansas Central's half of a 710 MW plant. The plan decks show those 355 MW blocks separately from the 710 MW block in 2031, so this placeholder does not duplicate them.

qa.recommendation: The announced step dates to the May 2025 plan update. The Evergy deck is dated May 2, 2025 and its Kansas Central page shows 710 MW of gas in 2031. The existing link in GEM is the viewer for that same deck. The earlier April 2024 update is not shown to include this block, but its chart was only read as an image.
